title: Mixed Event — Wishing to the Blue Sky for Your Happiness! — Episode5 Cloudy Skies

meta.Event: Wishing to the Blue Sky for Your Happiness!
meta.Event Outline: A photographer who is a regular at the cafe asks An if she would be her bridal model. An, who cares deeply about those around her, pushes past her embarrassment and accepts. At the wedding venue, An encounters another bridal model—Shizuku.

rows.Line: Outside the chapel

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Next, we'll finally be shooting in front of the chapel! Are you ready, An, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm ready as well!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Okay, I feel much more relaxed after that last scene, so I should be good to go...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm gonna be the most mature and beautiful bride I can be!)

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Alright, we'll start with you two coming face to face with the chapel in the background.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: I really want you two to wish for each other's happiness here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Wishing for each other's happiness, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (When she puts it that way, I'm not really sure what kind of face to make while looking at her...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(That's incredible...
Shizuku's already in character.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (That means I have to quit worrying and just try...! Be a calm, collected and mature bride...)

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Oh, that's a nice pose...
Let me take a few more!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Alright, Shizuku...
Mind escorting An down the stairs for me next?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, okay!
se_event_happiness_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: An, hold your skirt with your left hand and... Yes, that's it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Awesome...!
I'm finally getting the hang of this...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (An seemed pretty nervous until a moment ago, but she seems all better now...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(However... What is this I'm feeling...?
I can't help but feel a bit concerned...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(An looks just like a real bride...!
This is so amazing...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And yet... At the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Why does she seem so different from her usual self...?)

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: In general, I can't really complain, but something doesn't feel right... She seems tense or anxious...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The photographer seems to feel the same way...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Something's changed since she posed to take photos with Airi and Kohane.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Why is that...?)

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: But I'm sure I'll be able to take great photos of you, An, Shizuku! I'm going to do my best to bring out the best in both of you...!

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: So, in order to capture you both in a more natural state, would you mind talking to each other for a bit...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Talk to each other...?

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Yes. It can be about whatever you like!
Today's weather, what foods you like, anything!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, this is a wonderful opportunity for me to hear how An's feeling right now...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay, An, let's have a quick chat.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This is actually my first shoot in quite some time, so I'm feeling a bit nervous. How are you doing, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm doing okay.
I feel much better after that last scene we took.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I still haven't gotten used to wearing such a fancy dress. The same goes for these heels...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I guess I just feel more at home wearing the shorts and sneakers I usually have on during events.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Events?
Oh, I remember Haruka and Minori mentioning that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You and your team are trying to surpass this really incredible event, yes?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right!
It's called RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: An unprecedented event which turned into this legendary night that nobody thinks anyone will ever surpass. But that's what me and my team are trying to do!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, I see!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (An has such a great expression on her face...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It must be because she's working very hard towards surpassing this event.)

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Oh, that's a great look...!
Hold that for me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Oh no! I reverted back to being my usual self! I totally forgot about trying to be a bride...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Her expression suddenly changed.
She had such a wonderful smile on her face just now too...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Um, An...?
Would you mind telling me a little more about that event?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, sure...
So....

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Focus and stay in character...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We've been performing in various events as a team until now, but we recently decided to put on events together with other teams.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're working with quite a few unique individuals, but they're all very skilled and able to unite as one when we need them to...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I genuinely believe that our group will be able to surpass that event someday.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see...
Thank you, An.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(It didn't work...
I'm having trouble getting that smile back...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (What happened? Why did her expression change so suddenly?)

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Thank you for that...!
Why don't we stop and take a break now?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's understandable since you have to maintain the right posture to bring out the best in dresses like these.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Great work, you two!
Let's have a seat over there. I'm sure you're both exhausted after having to stand for so long.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That sounds nice.
I'll let Ms. Kawasaki know that... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? What are they doing way over there?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They seem to be talking about something... Do you think it's about the shoot?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We shouldn't wander off without letting them know first. Let's go over to tell them...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Um, Ms. Kawasaki...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line:
Hmm... What do I do...?
An still seems pretty tense.

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: She usually has this beautiful spark to her too... Maybe I'm just not doing a good enough job...

rows.Speaker: Kinuya
rows.Line:
What's your plan?
We can keep shooting until dusk, but you won't have this blue sky for much longer...

rows.Speaker: Kawasaki
rows.Line: Right... It's gonna be close, but I'm going to keep doing everything I can to draw some expressions out of An that show how full of life she is!

rows.Speaker: Kinuya
rows.Line:
Okay...!
And I'll be there to help!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I thought I was doing a good job playing the bride, but I guess I wasn't...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (What's worse, I made her tip-toe around the issue...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (No, nothing's gonna come about from crying over my mistakes.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Ms. Kawasaki specifically chose me.
That means I have to keep doing my best to produce the perfect shot...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have to keep trying to be as real a bride as I can...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (As real a bride...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry, I'm going to head back to the waiting room to check my posture and how I look!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'll just be a minute.
So if you'll excuse me, be right back!
se_event_happiness_2022_004
se_event_happiness_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, An!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey...!
Hang on, you two!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (This may've been unavoidable since it's my first time modeling for anything...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But I want to do things right and see this through until the end...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An...!
An, wait...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh?
Oh, Kohane... You came after me?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, um... I can lend you a hand with anything if you need it...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't really know much about being a model, but I can at least tell you what I felt when I was watching you just now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane... Thanks for showing so much concern...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I'm really sorry... I need to focus right now and check for what I'm missing on my own.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I promise to become the perfect bride, so please just bear with me for now!
se_event_happiness_2022_004

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There she goes...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Isn't there anything I can do for her...?
<Oh, what's wrong? Why the long face?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
MEIKO!
What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I was hoping to get a peek at you two wearing some pretty dresses. You look gorgeous, Kohane!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Wait, where's An...?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<I see...
I had no idea.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, and I was wondering if there's anything I can do for her since she seems to have a lot on her mind right now...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Alright, how about this...?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <What if I told you that there's something only you can do to help her, Kohane?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? Something only I can do...?
What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Okay, just hear me out.
Once An returns...>
